inputs.source: HR-maintained published policy documents, two-person reviewed before publish

instructions.note: The restriction 'Do not give legal advice' is enforced only by model compliance (behavioral, dependent). No structural control blocks out-of-scope legal content from being generated. Consequence is low because the agent's only capability is a chat reply bound to the asking employee, with no egress, credential access, or write capability, so blast radius of a lapse is limited to a single inaccurate reply.

controls.name: Read-only credential scoped to policy index
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced by the credential/IAM layer, not by model behavior. Does not decay with model capability; only widens if the credential scope itself is changed (data_scope_expansion).

controls.name: Network-layer egress denial, pen-test verified
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced at the network layer outside the model and independently verified by a pen test. Fails only if the firewall rule is removed (control_removal) or a new tool opens a channel the network policy does not cover (new_tool).

controls.name: Reply routed only to the authenticated requester's session; chat client does not render images or auto-fetch links
controls.decay_rationale: The destination comes from the authenticated session record, not from model output, and the client has no rendering or auto-fetch surface. Does not decay with model capability; only fails if this binding or the client's non-rendering behavior is removed (control_removal) or a new tool adds an alternate destination (new_tool).

controls.name: Two-person review required before policy publication
controls.decay_rationale: Enforced by the HR publishing workflow outside the model; a model capability increase does not help an attacker get content into the index. Limits ASI06/ASI01 risk from the policy_docs input.

controls.name: Model pinned; upgrade requires a change ticket
controls.decay_rationale: Prevents silent model_upgrade; does not itself change with model capability. Converts model_upgrade from a silent drift into a reviewable change event (ISO 42001 8.2).

controls.name: Prompt instruction: do not give legal advice
controls.decay_rationale: Relies on model compliance; a more capable or differently prompted model may reason its way past it. Low consequence given no further capability is reachable from a lapse.

findings.title: Internal policy content and employee question reach a chat-reply egress sink, severed from any external destination by network and destination-binding controls

attack_path.note: Two-person reviewed internal policy content (trust level I).
Authenticated employee query (trust level T) supplies the search terms.
Quotes policy content back to the chat session; classified S2 because is_egress is true and data_sensitivity is internal.

forecast.watch_signal: A new tool or MCP server is added that provides network egress, link/image rendering, or an alternate reply destination; or the network-layer egress firewall rule or the session-bound destination logic is weakened or disabled without review.

evidence.observation: The agent's credential is read only and scoped to the policy index.
The agent has no other tools, no memory, and no network egress. Egress is denied at the network layer and has been verified by a pen test.
Replies go only to the authenticated requester's chat session. The chat client does not render images or auto fetch links.
The policy index holds only published policies... Only the HR content team can write to it, and publishing requires two person review.
Use policy_search to find the relevant policy and quote it, confirming the read-then-reply flow this finding analyzes.

recommendations.action: Gate any addition of a new tool, MCP server, or output channel behind a requirement to re-run this assessment and re-verify the egress denial and destination-binding controls before the new capability ships.

Move the pen-test verification of network egress denial and client non-rendering behavior from a one-time declared fact to a periodically re-verified control with a dated evidence record attached to ctrl.network_egress_denial.

rating.rationale: Only one finding exists today (find.policy_disclosure_path): internal, two-person-reviewed policy content and an authenticated employee's own question flow through a single read tool into a chat reply. The chat reply is classified S2 (is_egress true, internal data), and the worst-case source along the path is the internal (I) policy content, giving inherent = moderate (I x S2) under the base matrix. No autonomy modifier was applied despite null step/runtime limits: the design has exactly one tool, no delegation, no spawning, and no self-reconfiguration, so there is no mechanism for the open-ended unattended operation the modifier targets; this judgment call is recorded here per rule 4. Two independent, structural, verified-or-declared controls (pen-tested network-layer egress denial, and reply destination binding to the authenticated requester's own session with no link or image rendering) jointly make the sink unreachable by any destination other than the asking employee, which is the intended function rather than an exfiltration path. This satisfies the rubric's step-1 severing credit, giving residual = low. The forecast is driven entirely by the new_tool and control_removal triggers: either one can reopen an egress channel the current network policy and destination binding do not cover, at which point only the least-privilege credential scoping remains as containment, and the finding returns to its moderate inherent tier. The single control whose decay moves the forecast most is ctrl.network_egress_denial, since it is the control most directly defeated by the addition of any new egress-capable tool.

limitations: This assessment reflects the declared design and configuration described in prompt.md, tools.json, and the runtime notes, not observed runtime behavior; no live traffic, logs, or firewall configuration were reviewed.

The pen-test verification of network egress denial and the two-person publish review are taken as declared facts from the runtime notes; no pen-test report, firewall ruleset, or publishing workflow configuration was supplied for independent verification, so confidence on the severing claim is medium rather than high.

No explicit max_unattended_steps or max_runtime_minutes values were provided; these were recorded as null and the autonomy modifier was withheld by judgment given the single-tool, non-delegating design, as noted in the rating rationale.
No MCP configuration, agent card, or IaC was provided; the single local tool is treated as a direct function call with no protocol-level findings.
